flags.title: Injured players cannot be sent down
flags.why: On the Major League injured list: cannot be optioned or outrighted until he is healthy and reinstated, so an injured fringe player keeps his roster spot by default.

flags.title: Post-season roster eligibility
flags.why: On the 60-day IL before the cutoff, so he is on the eligibility list. He has served the 60 days (137), so the only step is reinstatement: the club must open a 40-man spot and a 26-man spot before the series roster is submitted.

flags.title: Article XIX-A: five years, no forced assignment
flags.why: Posted from NPB/KBO: posted players almost always negotiate Article XIX-A consent rights into the contract.

flags.title: Article XX-D: the right to walk
flags.why: 4+058 of service (3+): may elect free agency if outrighted, now or deferred to season's end.

flags.title: Post-season roster eligibility
flags.why: On the 40-man before noon ET Sep 1. He stays eligible as long as he remains on the 40-man or 60-day IL through the post-season; an outright after the cutoff would end automatic eligibility.

flags.title: Option years and the 20-day rule
flags.why: 3 option years left entering 2026.

flags.title: Five optional assignments per season
flags.why: Optioned 0 times this season that count toward the cap of 5: 5 left.
